meta.name: presentation-generator
meta.description: Generate interactive HTML presentations with neobrutalism styling, ASCII art decorations, and Agency brand colors. Outputs HTML (interactive with navigation), PNG (individual slides via Playwright), and PDF. References brand-agency skill for colors and typography. Use when creating presentations, slide decks, pitch materials, or visual summaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成带导航的交互式HTML演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成风格统一的交互式演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn content into interactive HTML presentations with navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create branded interactive slide decks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成新粗野主义风格、带 Agency 品牌色的交互式 HTML 演示文稿，支持键盘导航和滚动翻页，并可导出为 PNG 单页图片或 PDF 文档。
howto.when: 当你要求创建演示文稿、幻灯片、推介材料或视觉摘要时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份关于项目进展的 HTML 演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会输出一个可交互的 HTML 文件。

say.text: 把这份 Markdown 大纲转换成幻灯片。
导出当前演示文稿为 PNG 图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate interactive HTML presentations in neobrutalism style with Agency brand colors, featuring keyboard navigation and smooth scrolling, and export slides as PNG images or PDF documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create presentations, slide decks, pitch materials, or visual summaries.

say_en.text: Generate an HTML presentation about project progress.
say_en.note: Claude will output an interactive HTML file.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown outline into slides.
say_en.note: Claude will use the md-to-slides script to generate a presentation.

say_en.text: Export the current presentation as PNG images.
say_en.note: Claude will use Playwright to export each slide as 1920x1080 PNG.
